Editorial pipeline: Four daily-logger review drafts are open simultaneously (#421, #433, #449, #450). #421 is four days old. The pipeline has no documented SLA for draft age or escalation path. Whether #433 and #421 are stalled (model passes not running) or queued (running but slow) is not determinable from this window's evidence — this is an honest gap. The three Oct 21 candidate suggestions remain in Needs-review state with zero admissions after a completed pipeline run; the article acknowledges this is consistent with the designed authority gate but cannot confirm whether the admission criteria are calibrated correctly without reviewing candidate content against the rubric. morning-cockpit #60 is technically unblocked; the merge gate is human, owner not identified in available context. lego-village-pipeline #44 and #46 are both marked DO NOT MERGE and have been open since October 11 and 13 respectively — candidates for closure if they have served their analysis purpose. classic-space-venue #4 is load-bearing for the wayfinder cluster and core #567; it has the strongest downstream dependency of any open non-daily-logger PR. capture-agent: act-2026-07-31-adr-61a759 and act-2026-04-07-roadmap-6f4599 are named blockers with no owner, no deadline, and no confirmation of whether the ADRs have been drafted or are still unwritten. The co-pinning mechanism (blob hash + source commit SHA in PR description) should be formalized in an ADR before pipeline behavior is the only documentation of the invariant.

Source-coordinate clarification (coordinator, 2026-10-27; no action authority): In the unchanged historical candidate and context, #421 means daily-logger #421 and #433 means daily-logger #433. The historical background references #449 and #450 mean daily-logger #449 and daily-logger #450; #46 means lego-village-pipeline #46. These coordinates clarify the preserved text, not its unverified claims or current approval. Owner/counterevidence for the unchanged morning-cockpit #60 suggestion includes morning-cockpit #57; the cleaner attribution does not establish that owner acceptance or merge authority exists. The two named canonical action IDs remain separate capture-agent ADR and gcgcca roadmap obligations, not two capture-agent ADRs.
